vopros: What is Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions in Tampa, and what do they do?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions is a Tampa-area accounting/financial-services firm that provides outsourced CFO and accounting support to businesses. Its services generally center on handling or improving a company's finance function without the company needing to hire a full in-house CFO/accounting team.

Typical work includes bookkeeping and accounting, financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash-flow management, and higher-level CFO advice such as helping owners understand profitability and make financial decisions.
